attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates self-employment tax per Schedule SE and IRC 1401. Called after net profit is computed so threshold checks work correctly.

condition_details.condition_comment: SE net profit meets threshold for SE tax; taxpayer.se_net_profit >= se_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Calculate SE tax with proper SS wage base cap and Medicare component; Calculate SE tax: SS component (12.4% up to wage base) + Medicare component (2.9% all income). EL translation intentionally deferred: postfix uses dup/exch to reuse taxpayer.se_net_profit * se_income_multiplier, and fmin/fmax to cap at the remaining SS wage base; a straightforward EL rewrite would not reproduce this stack-manipulation pattern.
action_details.action_dsl: set result.se_base = result.total_se_income * constants.se_income_multiplier; set result.se_tax = result.se_base * constants.se_tax_rate; add result.se_tax * constants.se_deduction_rate to result.total_adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.se_net_profit se_income_multiplier f* dup ss_wage_base result.total_w2_wages f- 0 fmax fmin 0.124 f* exch 0.029 f* f+ /taxpayer.se_tax xdef taxpayer.se_tax se_deduction_rate f* /taxpayer.se_tax_deduction xdef "SCHEDULE SE - Self-Employment Tax" job.audit_trail swap addto " Net SE Earnings x 92.35%: $" taxpayer.se_net_profit se_income_multiplier f* cvs strconcat " (IRC 1402(a)(12))" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " W-2 Wages: $" result.total_w2_wages cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Remaining SS Wage Base: $" ss_wage_base result.total_w2_wages f- 0 fmax cvs strconcat " ($176,100 - W-2 wages, IRC 3121(a)(1))" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " SE Tax (SS 12.4% capped + Medicare 2.9%): $" taxpayer.se_tax cvs strconcat " (IRC 1401(a) + 1401(b))" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Deductible Portion (50%): $" taxpayer.se_tax_deduction cvs strconcat " (IRC 164(f), Schedule 1 Line 15)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction per IRC §164(b)(6)(B). attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Counts EITC qualifying children. For each state_period the taxpayer experienced this year, creates a state_tax_result entity tagged with the period's state_code, marks resident vs non-resident based on a match against job.state, and seeds state_source_income from the period's allocated_income (computed earlier by Allocate_Income_By_State). attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates the General Business Credit per Form 3800 / IRC §38. Aggregates the seven component credits (Work Opportunity Form 5884, Research 6765, Low-Income Housing 8586, Disabled Access 8826, Small-Employer Pension 8881, Small-Employer Health 8941, Employer Paid Family Leave 8994) into result.general_business_credit_total, then applies the §38(c)(1) limitation: GBC used = min(total, tax_before_credits - max(0, tax_before_credits - gbc_threshold) * (1 - gbc_limitation_percentage)). Excess flows to result.general_business_credit_carryforward (IRC §39).

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.general_business_credit_total = 0; set result.general_business_credit_used = 0; set result.general_business_credit_carryforward = 0; add "GENERAL BUSINESS CREDIT (Form 3800)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 /result.general_business_credit_total xdef 0 /result.general_business_credit_used xdef 0 /result.general_business_credit_carryforward xdef "GENERAL BUSINESS CREDIT (Form 3800)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix: result.work_opportunity_credit result.research_credit f+ result.low_income_housing_credit f+ result.disabled_access_credit f+ result.small_employer_pension_credit f+ result.small_employer_health_credit f+ result.employer_credit_paid_family_leave f+ /result.general_business_credit_total xdef result.total_tax_before_credits constants.gbc_threshold f- 0 fmax /result.gbc_excess_tax xdef result.total_tax_before_credits constants.gbc_limitation_percentage result.gbc_excess_tax f* f- /result.gbc_available_limit xdef result.general_business_credit_total result.gbc_available_limit fmin /result.general_business_credit_used xdef result.general_business_credit_total result.general_business_credit_used f- /result.general_business_credit_carryforward xdef " Total component credits: $" result.general_business_credit_total cvs strconcat "; GBC used: $" strconcat result.general_business_credit_used cvs strconcat "; carryforward: $" strconcat result.general_business_credit_carryforward cvs strconcat " (Form 3800)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates household employment taxes per Schedule H (Form 1040 Schedule H, IRC §3501-§3510). Computes the employer share of Social Security (6.2% up to SS wage base), Medicare (1.45% on all wages), and FUTA (0.6% effective rate on first $7,000 per employee with full state credit). attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates credit for taxes paid to other states to prevent double taxation. When a resident of one state (e.g., NY) earns income in another state (e.g., NJ), they pay tax to both states. The resident state provides a credit equal to the LESSER of: (a) tax actually paid to the other state, or (b) resident state tax on that same income. This prevents double taxation while ensuring the resident state collects at least its share.
